title: ARD row
description: One computed value: one row per analysis, operation and group combination (PLAN.md section 7.2). Group columns use siera's stamping names. Version 0; a change needs an ADR.

id.description: The stable ID of the row, for example ard:An07_01/n/Trt_1.

method_id.description: The method registry entry that computed the value.

method_options_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical method options.

raw_value.description: The number at full precision; rounding happens once, at display. Null when the value does not exist (for example the standard deviation of one record).
